programmes.programName: Doctoral Programmes in Management (DPM, Teaching Track and Practice Track)
programmes.evidence: Official 2026–27 policy lists three doctoral delivery/admission tracks leading to the same PhD degree, each available in the formally named Decision Sciences and Operations Management specialization. All follow an original research thesis, final defence and viva. One award-and-field route is represented here; track variants are not counted as separate doctoral fields.
limitations: The PhD certificate indicates whether Teaching or Practice Track was completed; these are distinct tracks under the same PhD degree and area, not three separate award-and-field records.

branches.conclusion: Official 2026–27 policy inventories three admission/delivery tracks and all eight academic specialization areas; all three tracks share the PhD award and qualifying Decision Sciences and Operations Management field, represented as one route.
IIM Kozhikode's current academic and doctoral programme inventories are management-only; no engineering school or technical doctoral branch is listed by this institution.
